name: Sasoriza Desukoru
source:
Mysterious. Passionate. The Prince of Scorpio, a dweller of darkness.

With a middle-schooler chuuni mindset, he believes himself to be the dweller of a dark world. He has a strong core and is totally devoted to the concept of love. He is jealous and vengeful and hold grudges easily. He has an extreme personality that always wants to make the world black and white.
